leadText: Why won't you listen! (Japanese: いうことをきかない！ It Won't Obey!) is the second episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on October 27, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
plainText:
Why won't you listen! (Japanese: いうことをきかない！ It Won't Obey!) is the second episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on October 27, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
 

==Plot==
==Major events==
Madoka is introduced to Sora, Masako's son.
Kageaki Hiyama starts playing Pokémon Red on his own.

==Characters==
===Humans===
Madoka Akagi
 
Koichi Yadoya
 
 
Masako
Sora Karasawa
Midori Kudo
Oshou Kamo

===Pokémon===

==Trivia==
The fact that Farfetch'd's original Trainer is a Gentleman is a possible reference to Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!, where a Gentleman is considering trading his Farfetch'd for a Spearow. In the Generation I games, Farfetch'd's original Trainer is a .
It may also be a reference to the Pokémon Trader card from the of the , which features a man wearing attire similar to that of a Gentleman.
